column1: # Captured on 2026-09-18 with the arm64 macOS release host via
# `make test-css-cascade-memory`. The workload runs page load then one clean
# full recascade. It checks the CSS-role/canonical pools and the document-pool
# allocation caused by each cascade; the latter is where owned specified-style
# retention is observable. This follows D4.1.4v4, D4.2.1v3-D4.2.5v3, and
# D4.5.1v3: pool lifetime and allocator attribution remain explicit.
# The fixture set covers library-selector breadth (jqueryui), large external
# stylesheet input (linuxmint), repeated content cards (netflix), a high-DOM
# Bootstrap document, and two independently packaged web templates. Values are
# bytes except entries and bound_refs. The GTest allows 15% plus 4 KiB for pool
# extent rounding; a recascade must not grow canonical CSS beyond that margin.
# fixture phase document_live document_live_delta work_live_delta css_live canonical_live canonical_live_delta entries bound_refs
